clue.text: Indignation shown when last bit of foliage drops out of floral arrangement

indicators.note: the letter that drops out is removed from the word for a floral arrangement

parts.note: a wreath is a ring of flowers and leaves

indicators.note: the last bit of a word is its final letter, here of foliage

explanation.surface: A flower arranger is cross when the final leaf falls out of a display.
explanation.walkthrough: The last bit of 'foliage' is E; 'drops out of' removes it from WREATH.
explanation.definitionFit: Indignation is anger at unfairness, a milder synonym of fury.

clue.text: Unfinished due to bad weather drawn

explanation.surface: A match abandoned because of rain ends level.
explanation.definitionFit: First: a game called off because of rain; second: pale and tired-looking, as a drawn face is.

clue.text: Assume there'll be trouble with exercises

parts.note: ado means fuss or trouble
PT is physical training, school exercises

explanation.surface: Someone expects a fuss over gym sessions.
explanation.definitionFit: To take on a role or attitude, as in adopting a manner, is to take it up.

clue.text: In fifth form, one to get on

indicators.note: to form is to shape, so the letters are shaped into a new arrangement

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A pupil in the fifth form is trying to fit in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'form' looks like a school class, but it rearranges FIFTH with I and TO.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people who get on well have a friendly rapport, an idiom for liking each other.

clue.text: Royal icing to decorate the base of a macaroon

parts.note: ice is a noun for the sugary coating on a cake
to paper a room is to decorate its walls

explanation.surface: A baker uses royal icing to finish off the bottom of a macaroon.
explanation.walkthrough: Rice paper is the thin edible sheet macaroons are traditionally baked on.
explanation.definitionFit: Macaroons are traditionally baked on a thin edible sheet of this material, which forms their underside.

clue.text: Staff held a course

indicators.note: held means gripped, so one word goes round the other

parts.note: a staff is a rod or stick

explanation.surface: Employees kept a course of study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Staff' looks like employees but is a stick.
explanation.definitionFit: A route or way along which one travels, a path.

clue.text: Breaking out of thin cover, a deer

indicators.note: breaking out of suggests smashing up, so the following letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An animal bursts out of light cover in the woods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Breaking out of' rearranges THIN COVER A.
explanation.definitionFit: The chevrotain is a tiny hoofed mammal of Asia and Africa called a mouse deer.

clue.text: The way you attach an Afghan

parts.note: a path is a way

explanation.surface: Instructions for fastening an Afghan coat or blanket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Afghan' suggests a coat or blanket here, but it means a person.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pathans, or Pashtuns, are a people of Afghanistan and Pakistan.

clue.text: Counterfeit coin has to move slowly — flow limited by banks

parts.note: p is a penny, a coin
to inch is to move little by little
a beck is a stream, water flowing between its banks

explanation.surface: Fake money must creep along, like a stream hemmed in by banks.
explanation.walkthrough: Beck is a northern English word for a brook.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinchbeck is a cheap alloy imitating gold, hence anything sham or spurious.

clue.text: Run after stock car used in competition

indicators.note: after puts the letter for run behind the other piece

parts.note: a race is a breed, stock or lineage
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A stock car is chased in a race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stock car' is a false phrase: 'stock' gives RACE.
explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle built for speed events, motor sport's competing vehicle.

clue.text: Troubled over what's broadcast

indicators.note: troubled means stirred up, so the letters of the next words are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written, the S counting as a letter

explanation.surface: Someone is worried about what has gone out on air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Troubled' reshuffles the letters of OVER WHAT'S.
explanation.definitionFit: Radio on a band of high frequencies that carries signals across the world, a kind of transmission.

clue.text: Divided about wearing reversed jacket

indicators.note: reversed tells us to read the whole assembled word backwards
about here means surrounding, so one word goes round the other

parts.note: something divided has been cut
in can mean wearing, as in 'in a hat'

explanation.surface: Someone is unsure about wearing a jacket that can be worn inside out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' makes CINUT, which 'reversed' turns back to front; 'wearing' is the IN of 'in a coat'.
explanation.definitionFit: A tunic is a close-fitting military or uniform coat, a kind of short coat.

clue.text: Being ten per cent, I typify a percentage

indicators.note: a percentage is a part of a whole, so only part of these words gives the answer

explanation.surface: A ten per cent share boasts of being a typical percentage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a percentage' says only a portion of 'cent, I typify' is wanted; 'ten per' builds the percentage picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A being is something that exists as a distinct thing, a thing with its own existence.

clue.text: Bishop back without the rest

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one word goes round the other

parts.note: the rear is the back

explanation.surface: A bishop returns without anyone else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' has its old sense of outside, giving REATHER; 'rest' is a noun, a pause.
explanation.definitionFit: A short pause from work or exertion is a chance to catch your breath.

clue.text: Seductive summons

explanation.surface: An alluring call.
explanation.definitionFit: First: an alluring look or manner; second: an old-fashioned call to approach, literally 'come here'.

clue.text: Improvident compositor may be seedy

explanation.surface: A wasteful typesetter may feel unwell.
explanation.walkthrough: Sorts are the individual pieces of metal type a compositor sets; one who has used them all up is out of them.
explanation.definitionFit: First: a typesetter who has run short of metal type pieces; second: feeling slightly unwell or irritable, as one does when seedy.

clue.text: Held short assembly as a starting point

indicators.note: assembly means putting together, so the letters are put together anew

explanation.surface: A short meeting was held to start things off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembly' looks like a gathering but rearranges HELD SHORT.
explanation.definitionFit: A threshold is the doorway sill, hence the point where anything begins.

clue.text: It precedes the final passion

explanation.surface: Something comes before the climax of desire.
explanation.walkthrough: In athletics or racing a heat is a qualifying round before the final.
explanation.definitionFit: First: a qualifying round in a competition; second: intense emotion, as in the heat of the moment.

clue.text: Dissertations about gold — one speculates

indicators.note: about here means surrounding, so one piece goes round the others

parts.note: theses are dissertations
or is gold in heraldry
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Theses about gold come from one who guesses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps the dissertations round gold and one; the definition is 'speculates', with 'one' supplying letters, not meaning a person.
explanation.definitionFit: To theorise is to form ideas without proof, to conjecture.

clue.text: Expedition made by 29 to beauty spot

parts.note: 29 across is the underworld, and Dis is another name for it
a patch is a small cosmetic beauty spot

explanation.surface: An expedition to a scenic place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beauty spot' suggests scenery, but means a fashionable black mark on the face; 'Expedition' means promptness.
explanation.definitionFit: Expedition in its sense of speed or promptness, doing something with haste.

clue.text: The bird to change colour, they say

indicators.note: they say signals that the word is to be heard spoken, not seen

parts.note: leaves turn in autumn when they change colour

explanation.surface: A bird is said to change colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A tern is a slender seabird with forked tail, related to gulls.

clue.text: Blue shellfish

explanation.surface: Seafood that is a certain colour.
explanation.definitionFit: First: a soft lavender-blue shade named after the flower; second: a small edible sea snail.

clue.text: Leaders of Comanches, Ojibwas and Navahos have super powwow

indicators.note: the leaders of the words are their first letters

parts.note: fab, short for fabulous, means super

explanation.surface: Chiefs of three Native American nations hold a great council.
explanation.definitionFit: A confab is an informal chat or conference, a meeting to talk things over.

clue.text: Finally in command of foreign soil, in undisputed command

indicators.note: finally says the piece for in command comes at the end of the word

parts.note: de is the French and Spanish word for of
to soil is to spot or stain
i/c is the abbreviation for in charge or in command

explanation.surface: An officer finally takes control of foreign territory with absolute power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Finally' is not a last-letter signal: it says the command abbreviation goes at the end of the word.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyrant rules with absolute power that no one may challenge, so tyrannical rule is unchallenged command.

clue.text: Pulls the grass up

indicators.note: in a down clue up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: sward is grassy turf

explanation.surface: Someone pulls up the grass.
explanation.definitionFit: To draw is to pull, as a horse draws a cart.

clue.text: Spinner's pride's hurt

definitions.note: read as 'spinner is', so the definition is a spinner

indicators.note: hurt means damaged, so the letters are knocked into a new order

parts.note: the possessive is read here as the letters PRIDES

explanation.surface: A bowler's ego has taken a knock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spinner' suggests a cricket spin bowler, but it is a web spinner; 'hurt' rearranges PRIDES.
explanation.definitionFit: A creature that spins silk webs is an arachnid weaver.

clue.text: Pop round about alarm

indicators.note: round means encircling, so one word goes round the other

parts.note: pop is father, dad
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Father goes round about the alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: Dread is fear of something to come, synonymous with apprehension.

clue.text: Die from sword-thrust

explanation.surface: Death by a sword stroke.
explanation.definitionFit: First: to die is to pass away; second: in fencing a lunge or thrust is a pass.

clue.text: At a distance, a look from .

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or behold
of can mean from, as in 'a man of Kent'

explanation.surface: From afar, someone casts a look, the sentence trailing into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The dots carry the sentence on into the next clue, but this clue is complete by itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone standing apart, reserved and distant, keeps their distance.

clue.text: … cold man lacking guile

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man
artless means innocent, without craft or cunning

explanation.surface: A distant look continues: a chilly man without cunning.
explanation.definitionFit: Unfeeling and pitiless people are said to be cold, lacking warmth or compassion.

clue.text: Hand poet mutton chops

parts.note: a hand is a side, as in the right-hand side
Robert Burns is Scotland's national poet

explanation.surface: A poet passes along some lamb chops.
explanation.walkthrough: Mutton chops are whiskers broad at the jaw, not cuts of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Mutton chops are whiskers grown down the cheeks, a style of facial hair.

clue.text: The address one should use, oddly, for the dead

indicators.note: oddly signals taking alternate letters of the words, here the even-numbered ones

explanation.surface: Advice on the correct way to address the departed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' here takes letters 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 of THE ADDRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the underworld and its ruler stand for the realm of departed souls, by metonymy those who have died.
